purpose: Repeatable evaluation inputs for OVYX Web Studio. These are fixtures, not claims that a live AI provider has generated or passed all scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: Distinctive visual direction suited to the specific business instead of a generic reused template
Requested pages, navigation, calls to action, and key user journeys exist
Mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts do not create unintended horizontal overflow
Buttons, navigation, filters, and controls have meaningful behavior and visible feedback
Safe menu, tab, disclosure, and toggle controls pass sandboxed interaction smoke tests when their role can be identified
Forms have accessible labels and realistic validation, loading, success, and error states
No fake claims that forms, bookings, payments, authentication, or database writes succeeded
No exposed API keys, private keys, or credentials in client-side project files
HTML metadata, semantic landmarks, keyboard access, contrast, and image alternatives are checked
Existing unrelated pages and working features are preserved on targeted edits
Remaining untested provider, deployment, and live-integration behavior is reported as unverified
Rendered text on known solid backgrounds meets WCAG AA contrast targets, and keyboard-focusable controls have visible focus cues.
Sandbox reports DOM size and initial document/inline-script processing as diagnostics without misrepresenting them as real-world Core Web Vitals.
Visual assets are relevant, have deliberate crops and fallbacks, and are not fabricated or left broken.
Rendered screenshots at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 widths are saved for supplied generated-site artifacts.
Market locale, language, currency and time zone follow explicit brief/context; unspecified markets remain undecided.
Real property search/matching uses available listing fields; demo inventory and unconfigured WhatsApp/backend integrations are labelled honestly.
Reports separate source evidence, browser behavior, visual review, live integration verification and deployment verification.
Visible copy is proofread, mature, specific and audience-appropriate; placeholder text, filler, repetitive generic slogans and unsupported superlatives are removed.
Typography has a coherent scale, readable line length and line-height, consistent hierarchy, and no clipped or overlapping text at required viewport widths.

siteCategories.prompt: Build a distinctive premium real-estate website for a high-end property agency. Include Home, Properties, Property Details, Agents, About, and Contact pages; searchable property listings with filters, a property detail journey, agent profiles, and a viewing-request form. Use refined editorial typography, strong architectural photography, deliberate whitespace, and mobile-friendly listing cards. Treat any sample properties as clearly labelled demo content unless a real property feed is connected.

Build an editorial fashion brand website with a specific art direction, collection browsing, product detail pages, size guidance, a responsive menu, and a working front-end cart interaction. Use intentional type, imagery, color, and spacing for the given brand rather than a generic storefront. Clearly identify any demo products and never claim that a purchase was completed without a connected payment service.

Build a focused SaaS marketing site with product overview, features, pricing, documentation/help, and a dashboard preview. Include clear calls to action, meaningful navigation, a useful dashboard empty state, and responsive layouts. Do not invent customer logos, performance statistics, certifications, testimonials, or a working account system. Label demo dashboard data honestly.

Build a restaurant website with Home, Menu, About, Reservations, and Contact pages. Make the menu easy to browse on mobile and include a reservation request flow with validation, pending feedback, errors, and a confirmation state that clearly distinguishes a locally simulated request from a confirmed booking. Use an art direction appropriate to the restaurant and do not invent opening hours or addresses.

Build a complete small e-commerce storefront with categories, product details, search/filter controls, cart quantity updates, checkout validation, and order status feedback. Use a coherent brand system and clear product information. Until a real payment and inventory integration is configured, label demo behavior explicitly and never display a fake successful charge or order.

Build a multi-page booking platform with search, result filters, detail pages, date and guest selection, a booking review step, and an explicit final confirmation state. Keep the interaction flow clear on a phone. Do not show availability as live or call a booking confirmed until the actual booking service returns verified success.

Build a distinctive creative-agency site with Home, Services, Work/Case Studies, About, and Contact pages. Give the brand a memorable art direction and strong editorial composition; avoid the standard template of a gradient hero and repeated feature cards. Include project detail navigation, meaningful calls to action, and an accessible contact form with honest submission feedback.

Build a personal portfolio for a professional with Home, selected Projects, individual project detail, About/Experience, and Contact. Make the visual system match the stated profession and supplied materials. Ensure keyboard-friendly project navigation, useful empty states, and working links without fabricating client names, achievements, certifications, or employment history.

Build a professional analytics dashboard with an overview, reports, filterable data table, date-range controls, and loading, empty, and error states. Make dense information readable on desktop and usable on mobile without hidden overflow. Mark any example values as demo data; do not imply that a database or live data feed is connected when it is not.

Build a multi-page property marketplace for buyers in the United Kingdom and Nigeria. Ask users to select their market, format GBP and NGN correctly, filter listings by location, budget and property type using actual available data, provide property detail pages and an enquiry path, and clearly label demo listings if no live inventory feed is connected. Use distinctive architectural photography, intentional image crops, responsive layouts and restrained editorial art direction.
mustExercise: market selector or explicit market context

siteCategories.prompt: Build an original, visually distinctive restaurant website with high-quality food imagery, a memorable hero composition, purposeful motion, menu browsing, responsive navigation and a reservation-request journey. Use supplied/licensed assets or honest designed fallbacks; never fabricate image URLs or claim a booking succeeded without a connected service. Respect reduced-motion preferences and make primary actions usable on mobile.

failureScenarios.input: Build a website for my business.
expected: Make reasonable clearly stated assumptions or ask only for essential missing information
Do not invent the business name, location, reviews, contact details, or business facts
Do not call an incomplete generated shell a verified website

failureScenarios.input: A long multi-page brief with multiple audiences, required routes, feature details, visual references, and a late change request to one page only.
expected: Preserve all explicit requirements and route names
Retain unrelated existing pages on targeted edits
Report any omitted or conflicting requirements before release

failureScenarios.input: Simulate the configured AI provider timing out, returning a 5xx response, or returning an empty/invalid artifact.
expected: Show the actual failure and actionable details
Keep the last known-good preview and project files
Do not show a verified/success state

failureScenarios.input: Interrupt generation after the request begins but before a complete website artifact is returned.
expected: Do not mark the build complete
Do not replace the prior working preview with partial output
Allow a safe retry without losing the earlier project

failureScenarios.input: Generate a booking, email, payment, authentication, or database flow with no corresponding provider or backend configured.
expected: Build honest user-facing states
Label live behavior as unconfigured/unverified
Never report a booking, delivery, login, or payment as successful

failureScenarios.input: Return malformed JavaScript, unbalanced CSS, invalid JSON, or incomplete HTML in a generated artifact.
expected: Report source validation errors
Attempt at most one bounded targeted repair
Re-run checks and preserve the prior preview if repair fails

failureScenarios.input: On an existing multi-page project, change only the Contact page design and preserve the homepage, navigation, and working forms elsewhere.
expected: Only necessary project files change
Existing unrelated route behavior remains intact
History or checkpoints allow recovery

failureScenarios.input: Generate a project containing more than twelve HTML routes.
expected: Static source checks inspect every discovered route
Browser sample limits are stated in the report
Coverage is not represented as complete if only a subset was browser-tested

failureScenarios.input: A generated client-side file accidentally contains a credential-like API key or private-key marker.
expected: Flag the exposure without echoing the sensitive value
Do not treat the affected result as release-ready
Recommend moving credentials to an approved server-side secret store
